claims.text: VF/pulseless VT: if 2 shocks fail, epinephrine 1 mg IV, repeated every 3 to 5 minutes; defibrillate 1 to 2 minutes after each dose.
claims.quote: If this treatment is unsuccessful after 2 attempts, epinephrine 1 mg IV is administered and repeated every 3 to 5 minutes. Defibrillation at the same energy level or higher is attempted 1 to 2 minutes after each epinephrine administration.
claims.locator: Ventricular fibrillation or pulseless ventricular tachycardia

claims.text: If VF persists, amiodarone 300 mg IV; if VF/VT recurs, 150 mg, then an infusion.
claims.quote: If VF persists, amiodarone 300 mg IV is given. Then, if VF/VT recurs, amiodarone150 mg is given followed by infusion
claims.locator: Ventricular fibrillation or pulseless ventricular tachycardia

claims.text: Lidocaine is an alternative to amiodarone for VF/VT that doesn't respond to defibrillation and epinephrine.
claims.quote: Lidocaine is recommended as an alternative to amiodarone for VF or VT that is unresponsive to defibrillation and initial vasopressor therapy with epinephrine
